title: share-product dividend amount 0.010000 MNT (HALF_UP read-back of 0.005), normalised to 1 minor unit
_note: share-dividend seam. request.dividend_amount "0.010000" is shares-product-dividends-raw.json pageItems[0].amount, the exact decimal text the oracle STORED; expect.dividend_amount_minor "1" is that same value transcribed to integer minor units (2dp). This is the READ-BACK, not a computed rounding: the oracle received dividendAmount "0.005" and rounded it HALF_UP to 0.01 (the MANIFEST records HALF_UP 0.01 / HALF_EVEN 0.00, verdict HALF_UP). The port's exact-money parser refuses the 0.005 sub-minor-unit residue rather than reproducing that setScale(2, HALF_UP), so the rounding itself is a later slice and NOT graded here; this vector grades only the normalisation of the stored read-back.

provenance.note: transcribed from .softhouse/capture/shares/out/shares-product-dividends-raw.json (dividend id 3, pageItems[0].amount 0.010000). The HALF_UP verdict and the 0.005 discriminating input are recorded in .softhouse/capture/shares/MANIFEST.json roundingSurface.
